examples.title: Category label
examples.description: The default tag is a passive span with its existing label and content slots.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: All nine existing variants remain accepted, including primary, secondary and destructive aliases.

examples.title: All sizes
examples.description: sm, default and lg adjust the footprint. Long category values can wrap in a constrained row.

examples.title: Remove a local filter
examples.description: onRemove requests a parent-owned removal. Focus moves to the next or previous remove button, then Reset after the last filter. Keep Support cancels removal with preventDefault.

examples.title: Disabled removal
examples.description: removeDisabled disables only the remove control. The tag label and other native attributes remain available.

examples.title: Group and overflow
examples.description: TagGroup preserves its maxVisible default of two. A parent action can expose the remaining labels.

examples.title: Icon content
examples.description: Compose decorative icons inside the existing children slot and keep the readable label.
